_comment: Copy to .mcp.json (gitignored), fill in the tokens, then restart Claude Code so the MCP servers attach to a new session.

env._token_help: Supabase dashboard → click your avatar → Account Settings → Access Tokens → Generate new token. Scope: full account access.
Vercel dashboard → Settings → Tokens → Create Token. Scope: full access. Skip the Vercel block entirely if you'd rather set VAPID vars in the dashboard yourself.
